label: V6.4.118 - PERFORMANCE + STABILITY
notes: Reduce startup/update cost by loading runtime chunks independently, removing the unused Firebase Functions compat SDK, preconnecting the Firebase CDN, memoizing verified PWA manifest/checksum work, scoping dynamic UI normalization to changed DOM regions, and bounding/trimming roster Firebase status reads. Source monoliths remain build inputs only and are not executed by index.html.
message: V6.4.118: tối ưu tải trang, PWA, render mobile và luồng đọc Firebase.
